tei:titleStmt.tei:title: עַד־אָן צְבִי מֻדָּח
ʼAd-an Tsvi Mudaḥ — reshut No5 from the Old Sefaradi Tiqun for Shabbat Shim'u, by Yehudah ha-Levi

tei:div.tei:head: ʼAd-an Tsvi Mudaḥ — reshut No5 from the Old Sefaradi Tiqun for Shabbat Shim'u, by Yehudah ha-Levi

tei:lg.tei:l: How long the deer disowned and none recongregate?
Oppressed, he also groaned, with trauma sorely great,
How bitterly he moaned, at the looting of his state!
And his mocker, and his knocker, and his stalker;
on his nape a yoke they tied;
destroying without mercy, he’ll abide.
As “Violence!” I shriek, the Deity replies no more.
Therefore so very weak my heart, afflicted sore.
My back, oppressors wreak trampling to the floor.
I should worry, from the worry, roar in fury,
from a pit like Sheol, deep and wide;
destroying without mercy, he’ll abide.
Strangers’ heirs obtained all pleasant in my eyes.
And out to exile chained are my tribes and filial ties.
They destructively profaned my Temple they despise.
They killed in rage those young of age, and in rampage
my foes did shout in pride;
destroying without mercy, he’ll abide.
Salvation-doing Deity, pray rise and do be raised!
Redeem in mercy, Deity, poor folk who trust unfazed.
Shelter, with spontaneity bring our redeemer praised.
My Creator, bring our cure! No rock, I’m sure,
but You brings freedom’s tide.
No rock but You brings freedom’s tide.
